effects.setParam.note: effect parameter updates go through clip.update_effect

effects.list.note: applied effects are listed in the clip inspector and the JSON project inspector

effects.select.note: effects are edited in place in the inspector; there is no effect-selection model

effects.reset.note: rewriting all parameters restores defaults; no one-click reset command

effects.setKeyframe.note: editing a keyframe = setting it at the same time

effects.moveKeyframe.note: move = set at the new time + clip.remove_keyframe at the old

effects.setInterpolation.note: the keyframe command carries interpolation plus in/out handles

effects.toggleAnimation.note: the first keyframe enables animation on the property

effects.setDefaultTransition.note: transitions are added explicitly per edit; there is no default-transition concept

masks.set.note: mask nodes are reconfigured through node property updates

masks.translate.note: moving a mask = updating its node properties

masks.list.note: masks render as nodes in the node graph; there is no mask list command

masks.select.note: mask selection happens directly in the node graph UI

masks.remove.note: mask nodes are removed through the node graph; there is no dedicated mask remove command

lut.remove.note: no LUT library to remove from

mixer.release.note: releasing manual control returns the track to read mode

mixer.clearLane.note: clearing a lane = clearing the track's automation

mixer.moveKeyframe.note: move = add at the new time + remove the old point

mixer.inspect.note: the mixer is the Fairlight workspace UI itself; there is no inspect command

clipMixer.release.note: no clip-mixer control state to release
